title: FedFit: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Vector-Bank Parameterization and Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01537v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the massive communication overhead remains a critical bottleneck. Furthermore, applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in FL faces a fundamental "aggregation dilemma" between the accurate Sum-of-Products (SoP) and the communication-efficient Product-of-Sums (PoS) implementations. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedFit. First, to significantly reduce communication overhead, we introduce a disjoint shared vector-bank parameterization that reconstructs high-dimensional adapter matrices from two compact and disjoint global vector banks. Second, to address the aggregation dilemma, we devise an alternating optimization schedule. By cycling between decoupled single-bank updates (which allow for accurate aggregation) and joint updates corrected by a Residual Spectral Aggregation mechanism, we resolve the conflict between SoP and PoS. translated_title: FedFit：基于向量库参数化与量化的大语言模型联邦微调
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）能够实现对大语言模型（LLM）的隐私保护微调，然而巨大的通信开销仍然是关键瓶颈。此外，在联邦学习中应用低秩自适应（LoRA）时，面临着精确的“乘积之和”与通信高效的“和之乘积”实现之间的根本性“聚合困境”。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了FedFit。首先，为了显著降低通信开销，我们引入了一种不相交的共享向量库参数化方法，该方法从两个紧凑且不相交的全局向量库中重构高维适配器矩阵。其次，为了解决聚合困境，我们设计了一种交替优化调度方案。通过在解耦的单库更新（支持精确聚合）与由残差谱聚合机制修正的联合更新之间循环切换，我们化解了SoP与PoS之间的冲突。
tldr: FedFit通过不相交共享向量库参数化大幅降低联邦微调的通信开销，并借助结合残差谱聚合机制的交替优化调度，解决了LoRA聚合中精确性与通信效率之间的根本冲突。
